spans.s:
(I)--one of the २८ hells ever burning and under the earth; he who is self-centred and accumulates wealth at the cost of others suffers here; especially from animals, called Rurus (s.v) more cruel than serpents.
1: भा. III. ३०. २८; V. २६. 7-११.
False witnesses, men who are partial and speak untruth, people guilty of infanticide and of incendiarism go to this; also महारौरव;
2: Br.

.
those who perform rituals with joy and wrath also go here; below this is the तप।
3: Br.
(II)--the flesh of the Ruru antelope for श्राद्ध. M. १७. ३४.
--a सूक्त of the साम samhita1 recited in tank ritual. M. ५८. ३७.
--a kingdom of the West, watered by the Sindhu. Br. II. १८. ४७.
